intro_html: Sweet, savory, and a little garlicky, these bowls taste like a treat but cost like a bargain. Each one packs 52 grams of protein for about $5.07 a serving (at everyday cost). Fourteen servings means your week of lunches is sorted.
cost_closing_html: About $5.07 a bowl (at everyday cost) for a high-protein dinner that beats takeout on price and macros.
portion_html: Each of the 14 bowls gives you 52 grams of protein and about 651 calories.
upsell_html: This is the bowl that makes you look forward to opening the fridge at lunch. Members get every recipe in the Meal Prep section, plus the full library of money lessons and tools, all for $1 a month.
shop_smart: Grab the 8 lb ground turkey pack for the best price per pound on your main ingredient.
Buy frozen broccoli florets instead of fresh. They are cheaper, keep longer, and cook up just fine here.
One bottle of teriyaki and a squeeze of honey go a long way, so buy them once and reuse for months.
make_it: Heat a little olive oil in a large skillet and brown the ground turkey.
Stir in the minced garlic and cook until fragrant, about a minute.
Add the teriyaki sauce and honey and let it simmer so the turkey soaks up the glaze.
Steam or microwave the broccoli florets until just tender and fold them in.
Serve over cooked white rice with the sauce spooned on top.
